This article analyzes the target fulfillment rates for Indikator 8 across Danish regions and health clusters (*sundhedsklynger*) for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, comparing them against the previous 2021/22 period [^src1] [^src2]. The data reveals significant geographical disparities in performance, with a national average fulfillment rate of 15.9% for the current period, up from 8.2% in the previous year [^src1]. 

The established quality standard for this indicator requires a fulfillment rate of ≥50% [^src1]. Based on the latest data, only [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] successfully meets this target, achieving a rate of 57.5% [^src1]. Every other region and health cluster falls short of the threshold, including the highest-performing administrative regions such as [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (33.7%) and Region Syddanmark (18.0%) [^src1]. 

Among the leaders, [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] and [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] follow closely behind Midtklyngen with fulfillment rates of 42.5% and 42.0%, respectively [^src1]. At the opposite end of the spectrum, the trailers include Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F, which recorded a 0.0% fulfillment rate, alongside Sundhedsklyngen SUH (0.3%) and Klynge NORD (0.4%) [^src1]. These near-zero scores represent severe negative outliers when contrasted with the national baseline [^src1].

Comparing the current period to the 2021/22 baseline highlights substantial upward trends in several clusters. [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] experienced a dramatic surge, jumping from 11.7% to 42.0%, while [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] more than doubled its rate from 16.3% to 42.5% [^src1]. [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] also showed steady improvement, crossing the 50% threshold by rising from 47.8% to 57.5% [^src1]. However, this positive trend is not universal; Aarhusklyngen notably declined from 28.4% in 2021/22 to 24.1% in the current period, serving as a counter-trend outlier in an otherwise improving landscape [^src1].

For comprehensive details on the methodology, national guidelines, and other indicators evaluated in the 2023 and 2024 reporting cycles, readers should consult the respective introductory, methodological, and supplementary sections of the AFDK publications [^src3] [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17].
